paper.title: Ab initio calculation of real solids via neural network ansatz
paper.authors: Xiang Li, Zhe Li, Ji Chen

results.system_description: 3D homogeneous electron gas, N = 54 (27 up, 27 down), r_s = 0.5, simple cubic cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (DeepSolid (FermiNet-type) "Net") at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: Ewald summation for lattice sums (text); Madelung inclusion not stated explicitly, but BF-DMC column equals Lopez Rios 2006 values and Pescia et al. compare directly -> consistent convention. Boundary: periodic; HEG at a single (Gamma) point - closed-shell configuration, TABC used only for graphene (Gamma not stated explicitly for HEG).

results.system_description: Graphene, 2x2 supercell of the primitive cell of Supplementary Table 5 (C-C 1.421 angstrom, 52.9177 angstrom vacuum), 8 C, 48 electrons, all-electron, twist k1 = 0 in units of the supercell reciprocal vectors
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the neural-network wave function at one twist, before twist averaging and before the structure-factor correction (stated separately, 0.00122 Ha/atom).
results.notes: Energy per primitive cell (2 C atoms), Hartree, as printed. Twists defined in Supplementary Note on TABC: k1 = 0, k2 = (1/3) b1^S + (1/3) b2^S, k3 = (2/3) b1^S + (1/3) b2^S.

results.system_description: LiH rock salt, L = 3.4 angstrom (Supplementary Table 7 geometry), 2x2x2 supercell of the primitive cell, 32 electrons, all-electron, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the neural-network wave function in the 2x2x2 supercell, before the Hartree-Fock finite-size correction, which is printed in a separate column.
results.notes: Energy per primitive cell (one LiH), Hartree, as printed; the Hartree-Fock correction in the next column (-0.0099) is not included. The twist is not stated in the paper; DeepSolid's code defaults to the Gamma point, and Gerard et al. (arXiv:2405.07599) state that this calculation used the Gamma point only.

results.system_description: Periodic hydrogen chain, 10 atoms, bond length 1.8 bohr, all-electron, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy per atom of the neural-network wave function for the periodic chain; the LR-DMC(LDA) and VMC(LDA) columns are from Motta et al.
results.notes: Energy per atom, Hartree, as printed. Bond length 1.8 bohr (caption). The paper does not state the twist or the transverse cell; DeepSolid's config/hydrogen_chain.py uses the Gamma point and a 100-bohr square cross-section, which the instance takes.
